statArtwork.scope: STAT illustration only; does not alter world sprite or equipment
statArtwork.generationMode: built-in imagegen plus owner-authorized deterministic pixel cleanup
statArtwork.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE full-body transparent 8-bit PIXEL ART character illustration for the UNDERFALL STAT screen, not a walking sprite and not a UI screenshot.
Input image 1 is the character identity, clothing and pose reference. Recreate this SAME slim youthful heroine, recognizable chestnut-brown bob with loose strands, closed gentle eyes and small warm smile, narrow shoulders and natural human-like proportions. Keep the small navy collar and tiny golden closure, loose indigo/navy jacket with TWO coral-pink horizontal bands, dark shorts over fitted gray leggings, tall brown boots with purple-toned shadows, and the small thin violet ribbon hanging from the left hand. Her weight is on one foot, other knee gently bent as in the reference, arms resting beside her.
At the center of her chest preserve the luminous GOLDEN STAR from the reference. Make it a small sharply pixelated 8-point star with a few adjacent warm yellow pixels, not a giant smooth radial glow.
Style: authentic deliberately coarse 8-bit game pixel art, consistent aligned square-pixel grid, hard stair-step contours, flat limited color palette, 2-3 shades per material. Detailed enough for a STAT portrait around 64x96 to 80x128 logical pixels. NOT painted anime, smooth vectors, photorealism or a blurry filter. Do NOT enlarge the head into a chibi or turn legs into long bare legs. Preserve modest normal casual clothing. Hair / eyes / smile / outfit / pose are the same reference identity.
Composition: a single centered full-body cutout, portrait orientation, from entire hair to both boots, no clipped toes or hands. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA empty background and transparent padding. No floor shadow, no haze, no halo ring behind the body, no rectangle, no checkerboard.
No game interface, words, labels, logos, border or second character. No flower on the head, no witch hat, no cape, no weapon, no new accessory. Do not draw or modify the STAT layout. This is only the character artwork to place inside it.
